name: Butterfly chart (vertical)
purpose: Same contract as Chart-butterfly-h, rotated: two-series comparison per category as mirrored columns above/below one shared horizontal baseline — e.g. actual versus forecast by quarter. Semantic SVG in the DOM, styled by tokens, animated by CSS, behaviour by the ONE generated dv-behaviour partial (ADR-0015, worker fence — markers empty). CHART-EXPANSION WAVE 2 lane 1 (2026-08-05); ported from Chart-bar.reference.html's column x-geometry (REUSED verbatim) and Chart-line.reference.html's Layer-2 state model. Meta notes cross-reference Chart-butterfly-h.meta.json by DIVVY instruction; the two snippet files are independent.

props.name: series
props.$note: Exactly two series, one per direction. UP takes data/series/1 (column default, DV-D09); DOWN takes data/series/3, paired for visual contrast with the -h sibling's LEFT/RIGHT choice.

props.name: data
props.$note: A real <table class="dv-table"> inside the figure — the a11y spine AND the tabular alternative (dv-005).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state consumes the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: mirrored vertical, two series
variants.use: Compare two measures per category over a category axis that reads left-to-right (time, rank), both directions on the SAME scale so the halves stay comparable.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class (DV-D08): .t-cm-chart-label / .t-cm-chart-value = 12/500 · table .t-cm-legal 12/400 · title .t-cm-section-label
tokens.series: UP = data/series/1, DOWN = data/series/3; high-contrast remap data/series-1-hc / data/series-3-hc (data-contrast="high")
tokens.axis: DECLARED GAP (ds-020, DIVVY-instructed): Chart-bar's DV-D07 two-channel axis/grid CSS role is NOT ported. The one shared baseline carries colour via inline stroke="var(--baseline)" only, no gridlines drawn at all.
tokens.elevation: table popover + value tip = surface ground + elevation/functional shadow + elevation/border (anchored-overlay recipe, same as Chart-bar)
tokens.$survey: x-geometry (6-slot layout, all data-fx/data-fw fractions) is IDENTICAL to Chart-bar's column chart — reused verbatim, only the baseline y and the up/down y math are new. Layer-2 machinery ported by REFERENCE, not yet injected — AUTO-BEHAVIOUR markers are empty (worker fence).

motion.entry: Columns grow from the shared baseline (scaleY, transform-box:fill-box) — UP grows from its bottom edge (data-grow="up", bar's own convention, reused unmodified), DOWN grows from its top edge (data-grow="down", new keyframe dvGrowYD), 760ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), 45ms per-column stagger, CSS only (DEF-003).
motion.hover: brightness(1.12) light / (1.22) dark on the bar; legend hover/focus fades the other active series 24%, peeks a ghosted one at 24% (DV-D11, once dv-legend.js is wired).
motion.reducedMotion: Entry inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale text. data-pl="46" data-pr="12" — Chart-bar's own column margins, reused unmodified since the x-geometry is identical. data-fx/data-fw on rects, data-fx on the baseline and category labels.

mustNotNeighbour: A Stat-card making the identical claim in the same view

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="group" with a full-sentence data aria-label reading both series per category.
accessibility.name: The figcaption names the chart; each bar carries aria-label + data-tip naming its category, series and value (popover value == table value, one source).
accessibility.keyboard: Bars are focus stops (tabindex 0 + aria-label → value popover on focus, once dv-behaviour is wired); legend rows are filter buttons (once dv-legend is wired); table toggle = dropdown (aria-controls/expanded, Esc dismiss → refocus).
accessibility.nonText: Both series fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016). DIRECTION (up/down) plus colour disambiguate the two series — on-chart letter keys deliberately OMITTED, same delta as the -h sibling, receipted there and repeated here.

antiPatterns: More than two series (the mirrored-baseline geometry only reads for a pair)
Different scales for the up and down halves (breaks the visual comparability a butterfly exists to give)
Raw hex series fills (dv-017 — var() tokens only)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
Scaling the whole SVG down responsively (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
